properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js 4.2.0 ships MD5 (among AES, SHA-*, HMAC) in node_modules. No first-party call site — the package arrives transitively via merkletreejs. Collision-broken; kept because the primitive ships in the install tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test harness: @noble/curves secp256k1 reference arithmetic verifying the Solidity EC256/Schnorr256 libraries shipped in contracts/libs/crypto; the same secp256k1 curve IS the on-chain product algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-input generation only: random indices for merkle-tree removal tests. No keys, nonces, or IVs derived from it; does not weaken the shipped Solidity libraries. Recorded as the weak-random practice it is, with the non-security purpose noted.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves is the reference implementation the test harness uses to verify the product's Solidity secp256k1 libraries (EC256.sol, Schnorr256.sol). secp256k1 is the Ethereum/Bitcoin signing curve — Shor-vulnerable, deadline migration to ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test harness exercising the Solidity ECDSA256 library (contracts/libs/crypto/ECDSA256.sol) via its TypeChain binding verifySECP256r1; P-256 ECDSA is the shipped product algorithm here, Shor-vulnerable, migrate to ML-DSA on schedule.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/curves ships Ed25519 (EdDSA over Curve25519) in node_modules. No first-party call site found in this repo's sources or tests; recorded because the primitive ships in the install tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/curves ships ECDSA (over secp256k1/P-256) in node_modules; the test suite uses it as reference for the product's Solidity ECDSA libraries. Shor-vulnerable; migrate to ML-DSA-65 on schedule.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test harness exercising the Solidity ECDSA384 library (contracts/libs/crypto/ECDSA384.sol) via verifySECP384r1/verifySECP384r1WithoutHashing; P-384 ECDSA is the shipped product algorithm, interim CNSA strength but still Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is the hash of the EVM itself and of every Ethereum signature/address; here the test harness mirrors on-chain hashing. The @ethersproject/keccak256 5.8.0 lockfile entries are dependency inventory for the ethers v5 stack that hardhat pulls in.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @ethersproject/pbkdf2 ships the PBKDF2 KDF used by ethers v5 wallet mnemonic→seed derivation. No direct project call site; the primitive ships in node_modules.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes ships BLAKE3 in node_modules (dep of @noble/curves). No first-party call site; recorded because the primitive ships in the install tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes ships SHA3-256 (NIST SHA-3, not Keccak-256) in node_modules. No first-party call site; recorded because the primitive ships in the install tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider: crypto-js@4.2.0 in node_modules (transitive, via merkletreejs) ships MD5, SHA-1/224/256/384/512, HMAC, PBKDF2, AES, DES, TripleDES, RC4, Rabbit, and ECC curves in the install tree — including several legacy/broken primitives. Recorded as the shipped-library surface it is.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider: @noble/hashes ships SHA-2, SHA-3/Keccak, BLAKE2/3, RIPEMD-160, HKDF, scrypt, PBKDF2 in node_modules; dep of @noble/curves which the test harness uses. Availability surface — no direct first-party imports.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider: scrypt-js in node_modules (transitive via @ethersproject/scrypt) ships the scrypt KDF used by ethers v5 for keystore/mnemonic encryption. Availability surface — no direct first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider: elliptic in node_modules (transitive via merkletreejs) ships ECDSA/ECDH over secp256k1, P-256, P-384 and ed25519. Historically vulnerable to invalid-curve attacks; availability surface here, no direct first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider: hash.js in node_modules (dep of elliptic) ships MD5, SHA-1/2, RIPEMD-160 in the install tree. Availability surface — no direct first-party call site.
